test_name: Verify User Role Modification to Admin
description: This test validates the functionality of modifying a user's role to Admin and ensures that the role update reflects correctly in the system.
steps: Navigate to the Admin View page.
Locate the user 'Aishwarya Rane' in the user table.
Click on the 'Make Admin' button next to the user's details.
Confirm the role update in the dialog box that appears.
Verify that the user now has the Admin role in the table.
Log out and log in as the modified user to confirm Admin privileges.
Check if the Admin-specific tabs are accessible to the modified user.
expected_results: The user's role is successfully updated to Admin.
The Admin-specific tabs and privileges are accessible to the modified user.
edge_cases: The 'Make Admin' button is disabled for certain users.
The confirmation dialog does not appear due to a network issue.
The role update is not saved due to a backend failure.
The user is already an Admin and the action is redundant.
The session times out before the changes are confirmed.
data_requirements: User 'Aishwarya Rane' exists in the system.
The user has a valid non-Admin role initially.
Test data includes valid credentials for both an Admin user and the modified user.
Access to the Admin View page is enabled.
The database reflects the user roles accurately.
dependencies: The Admin View page is accessible.
The user database is populated with valid test users.
The backend API for role modification is functional.
performance_metrics: Time taken for the role modification API to respond.
Page load time after the role update.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the 'Make Admin' button is accessible with screen readers.
Verify that the dialog box is navigable using keyboard controls.
Check for sufficient color contrast on the role update confirmation dialog.
